note: The citing paper targets false dependences arising from conservative approximations in array data dependence analysis, a category the cited Maydan/Amarasinghe/Lam POPL 1993 paper exemplifies; the abstract's claim that 'methods currently in use generate false dependences' positions against prior work including this paper, though no direct numbers are compared.
title: Going beyond integer programming with the Omega test to eliminate false data dependences
